decisions.question: Which versioned persistence format, storage location, and atomic write and recovery boundary apply?
decisions.answer: Versioned canonical human-readable JSON artifacts are stored below evidence/workflow/<workflow-id> and bind schema version, stable ID, revision, and SHA-256. Writers use same-directory temporary files, validation, atomic replacement, and receipt-last publication. Recovery uses only the last fully validated hash-bound receipt; a database may only be a derived index.

decisions.question: Which signature or attestation method, trust-root boundary, and fail-closed validation apply?
decisions.answer: Receipts and knowledge packages use a versioned standard attestation envelope with a detached signature over the canonical SHA-256 content hash. A separate versioned trust policy allowlists the signature profile, key ID, and trust roots. Missing or invalid signatures, unknown trust, hash drift, and expired policy fail closed.

decisions.question: Which retention, archival, deletion, and legal-hold rules apply per evidence class?
decisions.answer: Governance, decision, and completion receipts remain for the project lifetime and are archived when superseded. Operational execution evidence expires 90 days after completion; security and failure evidence expires after twelve months. Legal hold suspends deletion, every deletion creates a receipt, and secrets or unnecessary personal data are not stored.
decisions.evidence: Thorsten explicitly confirmed adjusted option A for IRQ803 on 2026-08-07, changing operational retention to 90 days and security and failure retention to twelve months.
